item.title: How to sequence your DNA for <$2k
Chen-Ning Yang, Nobel laureate, dies at 103
item.description:
📝 Yang, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, professor at Tsinghua University, and the honorary president of the Institute for Advanced Study at Tsinghua, died after an illness, the university said in an obituary, calling the late professor "immortal". Since 1986, he had been a visiting professor at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. From 1997, he served as the honorary director of the newly established Center for Advanced Study — now the Institute for Advanced Study — at Tsinghua University and became a Tsinghua professor in 1999.
🔗 Read more: https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202510/18/WS68f3170ea310f735438b5bf2.html

item.title: Using CUE to unify IoT sensor data
item.description:
📝 I’ve been building a home automation system that processes motion sensor data from various IKEA Zigbee devices. The zigbee2mqtt documentation shows what each sensor exposes. Both detect motion with an occupancy boolean, but handling these differences in pure Go means type switches, assertions, and duplicated logic across every method that touches sensor data.
🔗 Read more: https://aran.dev/posts/cue/using-cue-to-unify-iot-sensor-data/
